svg.title: Company Card v2 — desktop contract wireframe
svg.desc: Desktop handoff at 1440 pixels. The main column presents identity, deterministic narrative, navigation, requisites, finance views F1 through F5, arbitration views A1 through A5, sources, limitations and neutral actions. A 320 pixel sticky right rail contains the claim call to action. Synthetic labels demonstrate long, missing, partial, signed, large-set, focus and non-overlap states.
svg.text: DESKTOP 1440 • flexible main + 32 gap + 320 sticky rail • synthetic contract handoff
